limits: The original baseline retained no terminal frame count, FFmpeg stderr/stdin totals or resource samples; 1216 was a live rendering poll.
The negative long trials were interrupted by backend 120 s inactivity cleanup during an observer stall under shared load; causation unresolved.
The ungated persistent retry also failed at 1712, so observer gating alone does not establish the cause.
Neither M4 memory-pressure behavior nor controlled representative-recording throughput is qualified.
CPU/RSS are process-tree observations with shared pages; old captures included the sampler ps query.

The full CDP run used opt-in worker phase packets; its wall timing includes trace/sampler cost. Encoder/Python tests overlapped the early part; unrelated host load rose from 52.58 to 129.68. Not controlled throughput.
Manual status checks additionally attached only to the page, never workers.
CDP and Playwright launch defaults differ; their comparison does not isolate worker auto-attachment alone.
All 82 worker resource-timing records in the full CDP run have invalid negative durations; no HTTP duration is derived from them.
Maximum main timer gap was 3349.2 ms under load; progress completed without pointer input but this is not a 100 ms response guarantee.

artifact_root: Worker checkout; referenced test-results/ artifacts are retained locally and are not committed to Git.

environment.graphics: ANGLE/SwiftShader software rendering; not hardware GPU qualification
environment.source_audio: 32 s stereo 48 kHz PCM16 220 Hz sine; synthetic fixture, not representative music
environment.load: Shared host with unrelated jobs; long probes overlapped some early short pairs. Not a controlled throughput comparison.

statistic_conventions.median: Mean of the middle pair for even counts; middle value for odd counts.
statistic_conventions.cpu: Maximum observed cumulative CPU time per PID summed by reported role; setup included, terminated processes may be missed. Old role parsing can be unavailable. No claims of codec-only CPU cost.
statistic_conventions.worker_threads: Sum of maximum observed cumulative CPU time per (PID,TID), lower bound when worker threads end between samples.
statistic_conventions.gpu: Statistics across all retained system-wide GPU samples; devices and unrelated workloads are not separated into export cost.

harness_validation_negatives.qualification: A completed 12-frame export uploads in a single batch and need not expose an intermediate progress value. The harness incorrectly required intermediate progress. It now requires final progress 1 and records intermediate observations separately; two consecutive exports pass after correction.
harness_validation_negatives.error: AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: Progress advances without pointer input

harness_validation_negatives.qualification: A caller-set 1 ms wait timeout exercised failure artifact retention, not an export reliability result. No default export wait cap exists.

prewarming_decision.decision: Defer; retain one initialized worker at a time.
prewarming_decision.basis: 4.28% summed startup/wall time; p95 929.6 ms, maximum 1728.3 ms versus unchanged 60 s wait. This measured cost does not justify a second live canvas and concurrent initialization in the reliability fix.
